What the fuck is up with that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback
Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

You can't just mess with someone's memory
using light...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Miu for a while?

If Monokuma can do it, then the gorgeous girl
genius, Miu Iruma, can do it too!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time helping Miu
make a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I somehow ended up growing
a little closer to Miu...
